status: technical feasibility research; application and real-account import not implemented

engine.license: MIT; preserve copyright and license when redistributing code; game assets are separate
engine.interface: Python JSON requests and JSON Lines batch; schema_version 2
engine.execution: Python worker processes; UI and optimizer remain separate from upstream
known_limits: A static enemy probe does not verify boss-specific patterns, survival, or real account accuracy.
Some skill effects and burst-gauge behavior remain unsupported or approximate.
The engine accepts duplicate characters and computes absent-profile members as ungrown; the application must enforce ownership and uniqueness.
Default layers may include strong equipment, cubes, and manual controls. Import must normalize all relevant fields and explicitly select operation conditions.

optimizer_reference.name: Jgaram/nikke-opt
optimizer_reference.conclusion: Reference exists, but public source availability was not established; do not plan to reuse it.

import.recommended_first_path: User exports growth JSON in their own signed-in BlaBlaLink browser, then imports that file locally.
import.public_url_path: Optional later adapter; existing services require public profile and roster plus an authenticated fetching session. A pasted profile URL alone does not establish an official unauthenticated API.
mapping: Join name_code to resource_id and the engine's canonical character name; display Japanese names separately.
Read limit breaks, core enhancement, affinity, skill levels, equipment tier/manufacturer/level and each overload slot.
Resolve option IDs with state_effects; retain per-line values and equipment-slot boundaries.
Resolve collection/favorite item IDs using versioned master mappings.
Read recycling research from outpost; missing research is unknown, not automatically a recommended default.
Preserve observed equipped cube and level separately; observed cubes are only a lower bound on cube ownership.
Preserve actual character/synchro levels; apply raid-specific level policy only during evaluation.
gaps: No real user export was obtained or tested.
Browser export behavior, CORS/CSP and server/region handling require a real signed-in browser test.
Upstream --from-raw still fetches mapping tables from CDN; offline conversion needs a pinned mapping snapshot.
Unknown characters/options/items must be flagged instead of silently discarded or treated as fully built.
import.credential_handling: The calculator imports growth JSON. Do not request that users paste login cookies or passwords into the calculator.

scenario_design.base: Immutable imported roster snapshot, timestamp and source version
scenario_design.scenario: Separate named patch over that snapshot; reset or discard without changing the import

kinds.realizable_growth: Skill level, item level/stage, overload lines/ranks and other legal discrete upgrades
kinds.hypothetical_stats: Direct ATK/HP/DEF or continuous percentage experiments; explicitly hypothetical. Direct base-stat overrides require an additional engine adapter; current JSON growth schema does not expose them.

goal_modes: Exceed a frozen reference squad result
scenario_design.comparison: Use identical boss, duration, operation and expected-damage settings; keep the reference result's build frozen by default. Compare unrounded values; distinguish > from >=.
scenario_design.search: Enumerate bounded discrete choices initially. More ATK or charge speed can change targeting/cycles, so do not assume monotonicity or blindly use binary search.
scenario_design.objective: Show alternative upgrade plans; minimum changes and minimum resource cost are distinct objectives. Claim minimality only within the fully searched domain. Report no solution within limits separately from search incomplete.
scenario_design.cache_and_resume: Key by engine/data versions, effective growth patch, ordered squad, cube assignment, boss and operation settings. Reuse only matching evaluations.

next_milestones: Implement a browser JSON exporter and strict local importer with field-level missing/unknown information.
Validate imported growth against actual in-game values and capture Japanese name mappings.
Add scenario editing and bounded single-variable target search on fixed squads.
Add multi-variable upgrade alternatives and resumable five-squad optimization.
